record.question: Which of the following is not a key piece of information, stored in single page table entry, assuming pure paging and virtual memory
options: A bit indicating whether the page is in physical memory or on the disk
A reference for the disk block that stores the page
record.explanation: A single-level page table entry holds the frame number and a valid/present bit (plus protection bits). A reference to the disk block holding the page is kept in separate backing-store metadata, not in the page table entry, so it is the item that is not stored there.
